title: Write each item's answerability model
statement: Give every question a written answerability model showing how its key or each rubric point is earned from the delivered sources and declared knowledge, so another person can recompute it.
detail: An AP history course's question record carries an answerability model beside its prompt, sources, key or rubric and scoring model, and each full long-essay and document-based item in its contract has a scoring and answerability model. Its rule is that answerability is checked before aggregate scoring: an independent reader should be able to recompute a multiple-choice key, or say how each constructed-response point can be earned from the delivered sources and declared course knowledge. A high average cannot make up for a wrong key, an impossible rubric point, a fabricated source or leaked feedback.

evidence.quote: Every intrinsic question record includes the prompt, source set, key or rubric, scoring model, answerability model, provenance, and evaluation state.
